entries.title: Scaffolding Kits shipped to the Muse Vault
entries.detail: PLX-418: 5 scaffolding kits added to vault.stevepeeleii.com — Morning Operating System, Content Flywheel, Job Hunt Engine, Money Autopilot, Desktop Operator. Each kit defines a framework (name + governing rule), renders an interactive SVG skill map (category-colored nodes, labeled interconnection edges, numbered orchestration badges, dashed framework boundary, click-through to real template modals), a cross-kit interconnect map (Quick Capture bridges Content Flywheel and Desktop Operator), numbered orchestration steps, and a generated copyable kit system prompt. New kits.js data file (validated: all 26 template refs resolve); deploy.py FILES updated. Deploy rides the vault-deploy-retry cron Thu 2026-10-15 13:00 ET after the Vercel 100/day cap blocked the 10-14 push.
